item.title: Let’s Talk Food: A foodie in Japan
item.description: My son Reid took me on a short trip to Japan to visit my friend.

item.title: Matt Calkins: The work never stops for Seahawks’ Mike Macdonald after Super Bowl win
item.description: RENTON, Wash. — Most of the time, when a sports figure says he or she is “humbled,” what they really mean is honored.

item.title: Spring training roundup: Tarik Skubal starts strong, Tigers lose to Twins
item.description: Two-time defending American League Cy Young winner Tarik Skubal delivered two shutout innings in his spring training debut, but his Detroit Tigers were blanked in a 3-0 loss to the Minnesota Twins on Monday in Lakeland, Fla.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn says surgery saved her from amputation
item.description: Lindsey Vonn narrowly avoided having her leg amputated after her devastating crash in the women’s downhill at the Milan Cortina Olympics, the American skier shared in a social media post Monday.

item.title: Kings snap franchise-worst losing streak, beat Grizzlies late
item.description: Russell Westbrook scored 25 points, Precious Achiuwa added 22 points and 12 rebounds and DeMar DeRozan finished with 19 to lead the Sacramento Kings to a 123-114 victory over the Memphis Grizzlies on Monday night to snap a franchise-record 16-game losing streak.

item.title: Judges grow angry over Trump administration violating their orders
item.description: The judge was angry. She had ordered a detained immigrant to be released in Minnesota, but instead he was let go in El Paso, Texas, where he had to spend the night in a shelter. All his property was supposed to have been returned, but the government was still holding his identity papers.

item.title: Mahuna formally sworn in as police chief
item.description: The Hawaii County Police Commission on Friday confirmed its selection of Reed K. Mahuna as Police Chief of Hawaii Police Department.

item.title: Planned new telescopes for Haleakala draw strong opposition
item.description: As the military moves forward on its plans to build as many as seven new telescopes on the summit of Haleakala, opposition to the project is mounting on Maui.

item.title: Toddler fatally struck by SUV in Waikoloa parking lot
item.description: Police are investigating a single-vehicle collision that claimed the life of a 3-year-old Waikoloa girl Friday evening. Police are not releasing the toddler’s name due to her age.

item.title: Trump administration scrambles to pick up the pieces of broken tariffs
item.description: WASHINGTON — The Trump administration has begun using a patchwork of trade laws to re-create the sweeping tariffs that the Supreme Court struck down as illegal last week.
